text: and the undo button still breaks the entire paint topology. again, this time i didnt have a broken piece i just didnt like the edit i made to the plane i had, and hitting undo made the eyes break again [Image #1] which they likely are not brokenn but they do this which is problematic
resolution: Fixed mesh undo flattening/scrambling detailed atlas paint after position-only edits. Transform, nudge, numeric scale, face winding, and the identity-mapped symmetrize return path now carry the exact atlas and durable paint program through journal installation instead of rebuilding from per-face centroid colours. The journal also snapshots/restores the UV-stale state, so undoing a structural edit returns to the previous valid paint contract while redo returns to the locked state. Verified with the mesh-journal unit suite, model-paint suite, binding codegen check, and full editor ReleaseFast build.
